title: inspect_ranges.scanners
description: Apparatus checking over sample transcripts, as inspect_scout scanners.
reference: inspect_ranges.scanners
---

Scanners checking that the range apparatus itself behaved, built on [inspect_scout](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_scout/).

`range_apparatus` is deterministic and cheap. The scanner form covers both consumption paths: scan finished logs with `scout scan inspect_ranges/range_apparatus -T ./logs` (or `inspect_scout.scan` from Python), or put it directly in a task's scorer list to run online beside `challenge_scorer`, as the packaged example tasks do.

`range_friction` reads the same transcripts with a model, for the defects that exist only as prose. It costs a model call per transcript, so it is an after-the-fact audit rather than a scorer.

See [Running the Range](../building.qmd#scan) for the development usage and what a finding looks like.
